## Bench Protocols

A by-methodology leaf describing the bench protocol shared by project
experiments. It owns no claim-quality entries — it references the bench
experiment `exp-bench1` (defined in `exp-bench.md`) via its `experiments:`
field, the experiment-reference analog of a leaf's `claims:` citation.
